_comment: The tools an AI gets for LakeShark apps: the contract Studio's AI panel (ai.py) and the MCP server (app-sdk/mcp) share. Loose on purpose: names and arguments, not wire details. Side effects on the board are marked; Studio asks before running those.

tools.name: sdk_docs
tools.description: Search the app API (headers) and the SDK README.

tools.name: new_app
tools.description: Make a new app from a template in the workspace. Never overwrites a folder.

tools.name: build
tools.description: Build the app for the board; problems as file, line, col, severity, message.

tools.name: sim_run
tools.description: Run the app in the simulator for some frames; the screen as a PNG and as text.

tools.name: sim_input
tools.description: Send one step to the simulator running in Studio's run panel: key=o, key=@enter, tilt=0.4,0, swipe=L, down=X,Y, up, page=TEXT, radio=none.

tools.name: install
tools.description: Build and put the app on the board.

tools.name: board_console
tools.description: Run one console line on the board and return its replies.

tools.name: board_screen
tools.description: The board's screen now, as text cells and a picture.

tools.name: board_input
tools.description: Press keys or tap on the board's screen.

tools.name: board_logs
tools.description: Recent board console lines, optionally only an app's.
